name: MCP Joint Osteoarthritis of the Hand
tags: mcp joint osteoarthritis of the hand
definition: Degenerative osteoarthritis affecting one or more metacarpophalangeal joints, less common than DIP/PIP OA and sometimes associated with prior trauma or metabolic disease.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess joint-space loss and osteophytes; labs are selected if inflammatory/metabolic disease is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent severe functional limitation may require injection or arthroplasty.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Hasta Sandhigata-Vata correlation may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative osteoarthritis affecting one or more metacarpophalangeal joints, less common than DIP/PIP OA and sometimes associated with prior trauma or metabolic disease.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
